name: Behind-the-Back Barbell Wrist Curl
cues: Stand holding the bar behind your thighs, palms facing back
Curl your wrists up and back to raise the bar
Lower slowly to a full wrist stretch

qa.note: Wave 3b 2026-10-09: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Wrist goes -40 to 55, and flexion lifts the bar about 12 to 15 cm up and back behind the buttocks. Palms face back with the arms hanging, the bar clears the thigh by 8 mm, and balance is 21 of 35 mm. The rear camera at az -145 shows both forearms.
